body:
CarePyre SIP Phone v0.23.0: real INVITE/ACK/BYE call signaling, G.711 RTP audio (AudioRecord/AudioTrack), and RFC 4733 DTMF now ship natively, replacing the demo-only simulate-incoming-call flow. Real bugs found in review: fromTag/toTag were header-relative not role-relative (malformed BYE as callee), reject() never sent a real SIP response, remoteUri used raw From header instead of bare URI. Known gap: Asterisk port 5060/udp not listening, blocking live verification against production (sudo-queue/58 pending).

⚓ ☃
title: Real SIP call setup + RTP audio + DTMF shipped
